_comment: The itemised catalogue. Drives the pricing page, the quote builder and the structured data Google reads. Prices are GUIDE 'from' prices in GBP including VAT for homes. Set "poa": true instead of "from" for anything priced on survey.
vatNote: All home prices include VAT at 20%. Business prices are shown excluding VAT.
guideNote: These are genuine starting prices for a standard installation, not teasers. Your fixed price is confirmed in writing after a free survey - it only moves if your property needs something on the extras list below.
includedInEvery: Free site survey and a fixed written quote before anything is booked
Heat-load calculation so the unit is sized to the room, not guessed
Supply of the indoor and outdoor units from a manufacturer-approved range
Up to 5 metres of insulated refrigerant pipework, drain and interconnecting cable
Core drilling, wall brackets and anti-vibration mounts for the outdoor unit
Connection to an existing suitable circuit, pressure test, vacuum and commissioning
F-Gas records, commissioning certificate and a walkthrough of the controls
Dust sheets, floor protection and all waste taken away
Manufacturer warranty registered in your name, plus our 2-year workmanship guarantee

groups.title: One room, one system
groups.blurb: A single indoor unit paired with one outdoor condenser. The standard choice for a bedroom, a home office or a single living room. Every one of these both cools in summer and heats in winter.

items.name: 2.5 kW wall-mounted split
items.spec: Bedrooms, home offices and rooms up to about 20 m²
includes: One slim wall-mounted indoor unit and one outdoor condenser
Cooling in summer, heat-pump heating in winter
Quiet-mode running from around 19 dB indoors
Handset and wall bracket; app control available as an extra

items.name: 3.5 kW wall-mounted split
items.spec: Living rooms and open-plan spaces up to about 30 m²
includes: The most-fitted size in London terraced and semi-detached homes
Handles a knocked-through kitchen-diner or a large main bedroom
Cooling and heating, with a typical running cost around 20-25p an hour
A++ or better seasonal efficiency on the ranges we fit

items.name: 5.0 kW wall-mounted split
items.spec: Large, glazed or south-facing open-plan rooms up to about 45 m²
includes: Sized for rooms with big glazing, roof lights or a west-facing wall
Larger outdoor unit - we check the position and noise limits on survey
Cooling and heating from one system

items.name: 3.5 kW floor console
items.spec: Under a window or in a dormer, where there is no usable wall
includes: Sits at skirting height rather than high on the wall
The usual answer in period rooms with cornicing, or loft bedrooms with sloped ceilings
Blows warm air at floor level in winter, which suits it to heating

groups.title: Several rooms, one outdoor unit
groups.blurb: A multi-split runs two to five indoor units from a single outdoor condenser. It costs less than the same number of separate systems, and - more importantly in London - it means one box outside instead of four.

items.name: Twin multi-split - 2 rooms
items.spec: Two indoor units, one outdoor condenser
includes: Typically two bedrooms, or a bedroom and a living room
Each room sized and controlled independently
One outdoor unit - usually the deciding factor in a flat or a conservation area

items.name: Triple multi-split - 3 rooms
items.spec: Three indoor units, one outdoor condenser
includes: The common whole-upstairs solution in a three-bed terrace
Mix of wall units and floor consoles if the rooms need it
Two-day installation in most homes

items.name: Quad multi-split - 4 rooms
items.spec: Four indoor units, one outdoor condenser

items.name: Five-room multi-split
items.spec: Five indoor units, one or two outdoor condensers

groups.title: Concealed and ducted
groups.blurb: Where a wall unit would spoil the room, the fan coil hides in a ceiling void, a loft or a cupboard, and all you see is a slim grille. This is what we fit most often in listed buildings and high-spec refurbishments.

items.name: Ducted system - per zone
items.spec: Concealed fan coil, ducted to linear grilles
includes: Nothing visible in the room except a slim supply and return grille
Needs around 300 mm of ceiling void or a loft above - we confirm on survey
Best planned alongside building work, before ceilings close up

items.name: Ceiling cassette
items.spec: Flush four-way cassette set into a plasterboard ceiling
includes: Sits flush with the ceiling, blowing to all four sides
Suits garden rooms, extensions and open-plan kitchens

groups.title: For businesses
groups.blurb: Offices, shops, salons, restaurants, studios and server rooms across London. Priced excluding VAT. We work evenings and weekends where a fit-out cannot interrupt trading.

items.name: Office ceiling cassette, 3.5-7 kW
items.spec: Per unit, installed into a suspended ceiling
includes: Standard 600 x 600 grid-compatible cassettes
Zoned controls so meeting rooms and open plan run independently
Out-of-hours installation available at no premium on planned works

items.name: Server and comms room cooling
items.spec: Continuous-duty system with remote fault alarm
includes: Rated for year-round running, including sub-zero outdoor temperatures
Volt-free alarm contact wired to your monitoring or a dialler
Optional N+1 pair so one unit can fail without taking the room down

items.name: VRF / VRV system, designed and installed
includes: Full heat-load design, drawings and O&M manual
Staged installation around your trading hours or fit-out programme
Handover with BMS or standalone central controller

items.name: TM44 air conditioning inspection
items.spec: Legally required for systems over 12 kW, every five years
includes: Carried out by an accredited energy assessor
Report lodged on the national register
Covers the enforcement requirement under the Energy Performance of Buildings Regulations

extras.name: Refrigerant pipe run beyond the first 5 metres
extras.note: Common when the outdoor unit has to go at the front of the house or down at garden level.

extras.name: Condensate pump
extras.note: Needed where the drain cannot fall away under gravity - typical in flats and internal rooms.

extras.name: Slimduct cosmetic trunking, painted to match
extras.note: Boxes in the external pipework neatly instead of leaving taped insulation on the wall.

extras.name: New dedicated 16 A circuit and RCBO
extras.note: Required where your consumer unit has no suitable spare way. Part P certified.

extras.name: Consumer unit upgrade
extras.note: Only where an older board cannot safely take the additional circuit.

extras.name: High-level, roof or parapet mounting
extras.note: Covers tower hire, roof access and the additional fixings and safety kit.

extras.name: Ground-mounted condenser on anti-vibration feet
extras.note: Instead of wall brackets, where the unit sits on a patio or flat roof.

extras.name: Wi-Fi controller and app set-up
extras.note: Control from your phone, plus schedules and holiday mode. Works with Alexa and Google Home.

extras.name: Making good and decorating after core drilling
extras.note: Filled, sanded and touched in. Most customers only need this on a front elevation.

extras.name: Removing an old system, with refrigerant recovery
extras.note: Legally recovered and disposed of, with the paperwork to prove it.

extras.name: Planning drawing pack for a council application
extras.note: Elevations, unit position and specification, prepared for submission.

extras.name: Acoustic report for a planning application
extras.note: A BS 4142 noise assessment. Several London boroughs ask for one before they will approve an outdoor unit.

care.name: Annual service, one indoor unit
care.note: Filters, coils, drain, refrigerant check, electrical check and a written report.

care.name: Each additional indoor unit on the same visit
Cool Care - two visits a year
care.note: Pre-summer and pre-winter checks, priority booking, and 10% off any repair.

care.name: 5-year parts and labour warranty
care.note: Kept in force by the annual service. Most manufacturers require servicing to honour their own warranty anyway.

care.name: Repair callout, first hour
care.note: Waived if the fault turns out to be our workmanship, whatever the age of the install.

care.name: Statutory leak test for business systems
care.note: Required by the F-Gas Regulation for systems above 5 tonnes CO2 equivalent.
